description: Ridge AL(nT) from 5-min solar wind. Features (order): newell, sqrt(newell), vBs, V, n, Bz, then trailing means over 3/12/36 samples of (newell, vBs) pairs. newell = V^(4/3)*BT^(2/3)*sin(theta/2)^(8/3), BT=hypot(By,Bz) GSM, theta=atan2(|By|,Bz), vBs=V*max(0,-Bz). Trained OMNI 5-min 2015-2017 vs Kyoto AL; held-out 2018 r=0.769.
